# Psalm 98 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 98:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Has-made-known YHWH his-salvation; before-eyes-of the-nations he-has-revealed his-righteousness.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD has made known his salvation; he has revealed his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD has announced his salvation! He has shown the nations what his justice looks like.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
